description: Search exhibitors' product listings and profiles across the whole fair. Returns totals and the best-matching exhibitors with their matching listings. Use product words only (e.g. 'bamboo cutting board'). Optional filters apply to the exhibitors returned. Spends one search.

certificate.description: A certificate the exhibitor must list, e.g. BSCI, FDA, LFGB, UL/ETL, OEKO-TEX, FSC

name: search_listings
title: Search exhibitor listings
